integrity: The theorem is analytic. A bundled standard-library script checks the algebra and a representative parameter instance but is supplementary, not a substitute for the proof. The motivating article's equations, equilibrium section, next-generation calculation, global-stability statement, and sensitivity section were inspected directly.
scientific_limitations: Only the antibody-free endemic branch and its transverse antibody eigenvalue are classified; the remaining five eigenvalues are not.
No transcritical-bifurcation claim is made at the humoral-invasion threshold.
The positive-antibody endemic branch and global dynamics for strictly positive antibody initial data are not reclassified.
Generic humoral-invasion thresholds are known in earlier virus models; the new content is the exact source-specific branch and sharp threshold for this HPV system.
title: A missing antibody-free endemic branch and a separate humoral-invasion threshold in an HPV model
